faqs.question: When is the Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is set to take place on September 5, 2026. The event will be held at Dewan Jubli Perak in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, Malaysia, serving as the central venue for the race weekend.

faqs.question: What distances can I run?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance categories at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options makes the event accessible to both serious runners and casual participants looking for a shorter distance.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is jointly organized by Yayasan KB Care and the Kerajaan Negeri Kelantan, the state government of Kelantan. This partnership between a foundation and the state government suggests official backing and support for the race.

faqs.question: Is registration open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Prospective participants can sign up now for any of the three available distances -- 21.1km, 10km, or 5km -- ahead of the race day on September 5, 2026.
